title: linaria supina
intro: Linaria supina, commonly known as Needle Spurred Catchfly or Low Toadflax, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Linaria supina include anti-spasmodic and anti-asthmatic properties, which can help to calm respiratory issues and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
